replies.body:
Hi again,
Even if your cousin has access to your account away from your home, then the IPs would have been different. We have every right to punish users for ban evading even shortly after their punishment expires. Do not appeal again, you have been denied. Forum bans may be handed out, just reminding you.

Thanks.
